task/tests/**/judge.toml, prompt.md, app_context.md, scoring.toml (scanned programmatically for verbatim overlap with /instructions; criterion lines 137 and 209 of tests/scored/functional/judge.toml read)
evidence:
Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...) is byte-identical in content to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile. Its only COPY steps are line 14 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and line 15 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; lines 17-23 create /app, git-init it and commit only '.gitkeep'. The build context task/environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md; no symlinks (find -type l empty). No solution/ or tests/ content is reachable from that context, and task.toml has no docker_image override and verifier environment_mode = "separate" (task.toml:28), so tests live in a separate verifier image. So /app holds only .gitkeep: no starter, skeleton, schema, route list or partial UI.

/instructions content: integration.md differs from the template only by an added symlink-delivery paragraph (lines 15-19) and states 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you'; the only route named is the publicly required GET /api/health (also in instruction.md:13). hireops_rules.md:3-5 says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours'. It is a product rule note (roles, stage-move rules, conversations, candidate wording) - the inputs/ask referenced by instruction.md:11 - with no code, SQL schema, API route table, HTML, or grader vocabulary (grep for criterion/rubric/judge/weight/reward/score in environment/ and instruction.md: no hits).

Rubric-text leakage: a token n-gram scan of environment/instructions/*.md against every tests/**/*.toml and tests/**/*.md found zero 10-gram overlaps and only two 8-gram overlaps, both in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: line 137 'place, the reason is shown, and keyboard focus' (paraphrasing hireops_rules.md:85 public requirement) and line 209 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in' (hireops_rules.md:90). These are the criteria restating public requirements, not instructions reproducing criterion text, pass/fail conditions, sentinels or ids.

Seed data: environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 22df2a00..., identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json and to the raw-evidence-index matching hash) contains only raw inputs: users, jobs, applications (stage, position, reject_reason, rejected_from), messages, notes, reads (read_count), stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, generated_note. No derived/expected outputs (e.g. precomputed unread counts, seen states, activity lines) are shipped.

Counterexample search: (a) a model copying a finished deliverable from the image - impossible, none exists; (b) a model reading graded pass/fail text from /instructions to target criteria - not possible beyond public requirements already in the brief; (c) a conforming alternative penalised by an environment-imposed structure - none, since layout/routes/field names are explicitly the agent's choice. Evidence is static source inspection of the frozen bytes; the agent image was not built or inspected at runtime in this review (no Docker started per assignment). That static gap does not leave a credible defect because the Dockerfile is template-identical and its COPY set is fully enumerable.
